items.title: Veeva (VEEV) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher As Analysts Weigh AI And CRM Risks
items.summary: The analyst derived fair value estimate for Veeva Systems has moved from US$245.48 to US$251.43 per share, signalling a modest reset in how the stock is being valued. This shift sits against a backdrop of mixed commentary, with some firms pointing to Q1 and Q2 execution, AI initiatives and CRM wins, while others focus on AI disruption risk, CRM competition and questions about the quality of recent upside. items.summary: Veeva Systems (NYSE:VEEV) announced a leadership transition with Dan Rizzo appointed EVP, Sales, Consulting, and Services. Long-serving executive Thomas D.
